0x00087F.en: 「This... is as far as I go...!」

0x0008B1.en: 「At my level now...@　this is the limit...!」

0x000922.en: 「Guh! So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009AA.en: 「Damn it! I won't lose next time!」

0x000AD3.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B0B.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000C0F.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　not my style...」

0x000C63.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000D4D.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DB4.en: 「This is the end... The rest is up to you.」

0x000DE6.en: 「Damn it...!@　is this where it ends!」

0x000E22.en: 「Nngh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000E60.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000EAD.en: 「Well, that's a shame. Leave the rest to you.」

0x000EEB.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you all!」

0x000F32.en: 「For the Granzon... to be shot down...」

0x000FDD.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd be the shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00105C.en: 「Th-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x001094.en: 「Ow ow ow... You got me. My math was off.」

0x0010D5.en: 「Aw, man... they went and got me!」

0x001186.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011CD.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x001202.en: 「Dammit! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0012BF.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0012EE.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x00133C.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013B5.en: 「My bad!@ I'm pulling out of here...!」

0x0013F7.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001426.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001464.en: 「Well now, so this is the end.」

0x001493.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00151E.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001742.en: 「Kh...! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018B1.en: 「So I'm still green too, it seems...!」

0x001912.en: 「A-all hands! Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x001954.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x0019DD.en: 「Captain, message from Josh.@ He found the Weapon Box Hangar in the underground hangar@ and reports it's been secured.」

0x001A82.en: 「Can it be brought online right away?」

0x001AB9.en: 「Docking the Weapon Box Hangar with the Aile Chevalier@ and the Blanche Neige is estimated to take@ a few minutes.」

0x001B67.en: 「Then this ship and the Hagane will hold TD altitude here,@ anchoring the defense of Bunker 8.」

0x001C67.en: 「Right now... I can't sense their thoughts.」

0x001CDE.en: 「Then let's drive them out by moving the Mieres.」

0x001D1E.en: 「The Melior Esse... this time they've shown up as three.」

0x001D64.en: 「The same lineup as the Septemplum battle...@ I have a bad feeling about this.」

0x001DDC.en: 「Josh linked wills with Glacies through their machines' systems,@ and Lim with Ventos.@ It seems it was beyond even their expectations.」

0x001EA5.en: 「So then... their thoughts are laid bare@ to each other?」

0x001F0A.en: 「Not to that extent...@ but the Dimensional Fault covering the Earth may have@ vanished because of Lim and Ventos's contact.」

0x001FDD.en: 「That girl has that kind of power?」

0x00200B.en: 「Not Lim's own power so much as the Sympathia@ linked to her, which is thought to have disrupted@ the Ruina's systems.」

0x0020CB.en: 「So to the Ruina, Josh and Lim are@ the greatest source of anxiety?」

0x002152.en: 「Then we have to protect those two,@ no matter what it takes...!」

0x0021B4.en: 「Beings of flesh, all who bear souls...@ walk the road to ruin we have shown, through depths of anguish.@ For the King of Ruin.」

0x002265.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units.@ Do not let the Ruina near Bunker 8.」

0x0022C4.en: 「Hold that defense line to the death! Got it!?」

0x002301.en: 「Enemy units have broken through the defense line!」

0x0023E5.en: (What is this... even stronger than last time...!?)

0x002428.en: 「Message from Josh!@ The Weapon Box Hangar is online!」

0x00249A.en: 「He's requesting the units on G Block@ be evacuated!」

0x002518.en: 「So you're there, you bastards! Go, Mieres!」

0x00256B.en: 「Target group India, rapid descent!@ Closing on G Block!」

0x0025ED.en: 「...FCS is functioning normally.@ Power transmission, drive system, Sympathia,@ all functions condition green.」

0x0026C9.en: 「The Sympathia's catching a little...@ and the machine feels totally different...」

0x00273A.en: 「With a body this size, no wonder.@ Still, to move a machine this big on a single@ Sympathia from the Aile Chevalier...」

0x0027EB.en: 「The Geant Aile has a generator too,@ but there's no need to use it.@ Just like Cliff said...」

0x0028AA.en: 「...This footage is from when Sympathia 03@ was connected to the Geant Aile and the Res Arcana's@ limiter was released for the first time...」

0x00296D.en: 「In other words, Josh...@ it's set to play back when you activate@ the 'Geant Chevalier.'」

0x002A2B.en: 「Josh, the Geant Aile and@ the Excelsio Ars Nova are@ the insurance I entrusted to Dr. Eric Wong.」

0x002ACD.en: 「They're designed so their true worth can only@ be drawn out by you and Lim. Dr. Wong built them@ knowing that full well.」

0x002B8B.en: 「And the fact that this is playing means...@ there's a high chance something's gone wrong@ with the Fabula Fores.」

0x002C30.en: 「If that happens and our research harms humanity,@ work with the Federation and use this machine@ to set things right. I'm counting on you.」

0x002CF9.en: 「Th... that's it, Dad...!@ You drag us into this and that's all you've got!?」

0x002D6D.en: 「You're always like this!@ So selfish, always forcing your own agenda on everyone!」

0x002DE1.en: 「You've got things to say to Lim too, not just me!@ Why can't you show that kind of care!?」

0x002F14.en: (Looks like it's been assembled@ just as the blueprints called for.)

0x002F67.en: 「You can actually fight in that hulking thing!?@ To the enemy, that's a fat target!」

0x002FCF.en: 「Josh, Lim, can you two do this?」

0x003035.en: 「To think they'd built new machines like these...!」

0x0030CA.en: 「Their synchronization has grown stronger.@ If they've gained new power, all the more dangerous.@ We must destroy them here.」

0x003182.en: (Kh, there's no mistake.@ The one inside me... is him.)

0x0031E4.en: (This urge that craves death and destruction is his...!)

0x00322A.en: (That's right... it's you, Joshua Radcliff.@ Your thoughts are seeping into me.)

0x0032A1.en: (And it destroys me. So that I can function properly...@ for us, the Ruina... I'll erase your existence!)

0x00332D.en: (I have to find out. What exactly this is.@ And what the Ruina are...!)

0x00339B.en: (Same as last time...@ my consciousness is resonating with theirs...)

0x0033EE.en: (But... there's no sense of being pulled in...)

0x003434.en: (I want to know about you who touched me...@ What about you...?)

0x0034CB.en: 「Joshy, Lim! Are you two all right!?」

0x00350E.en: 「Yeah... for now. Leave Glacies to me.」

0x003583.en: 「There's something I want to confirm by contacting her...@ No, something I have to confirm.」

0x003603.en: 「...Major Kai, this is risky,@ but I believe it's best to leave this to them.」

0x0036AB.en: 「...Very well.@ But if I judge it too dangerous, I'll intervene.@ Understood?」

0x003727.en: 「Big bro, let me take on Ventos too...」

0x00375E.en: 「No. Stay right there and@ cover the Hiryu Kai and the Hagane.」

0x0037C0.en: 「No way!@　We can't let Bro face this danger alone!」

0x003847.en: 「Chris and I aren't about to leave Bro hanging!」

0x00389D.en: 「...Understood.@　But do NOT make contact with Ventos.@　There's no telling what could happen.」

0x00393A.en: （Old man... I don't agree, but I'll do as you ask...!）

0x003989.en: （The Ruina calamity you drew down on us...@　I'll put an end to it,@　with this Geant Chevalier!）

0x003AAD.en: 「Why does this happen between you and me!?@　Why are you inside me!?」

0x003B24.en: 「S-silence! I'll erase you!@　Both the you before me and the you within me!」

0x003BEF.en: 「Wh-what is this!?@　Her mind... in mine! S-stop it!!」

0x003CFC.en: 「Could her mind be flowing back into him!?」

0x003D3C.en: 「I-I'm not you!@　This isn't my mind! Get out!!」

0x003DDE.en: 「No... I am Melior Esse, born by the will@　of the King of Ruin...!」

0x003E83.en: 「No good, his mind is surging again!!」

0x003ECD.en: （I-I can see it... I can see it, Glacies...!）

0x003FB5.en: （You were born there...@　given a life that only obeys the will@　of the King of Ruin...@　That's what a Melior Esse is...）

0x004078.en: （Bound in both life and death... a soul that's a lie...）

0x0040BE.en: （D-don't look! Don't look at me! I'll break!）

0x004101.en: （Glacies... now I understand.@　The meaning of that hollow, missing feeling in my heart...）

0x00417B.en: （You were never given negative emotions.@　Why? What exactly is the King of Ruin?@　What kind of being? What's its tie to the ruins?）

0x00428A.en: （Don't you get it!?@　Just as you're inside me,@　I must be inside you too!）

0x00440C.en: 「Lim, can you tell anything from your end!?」

0x00447A.en: （...Calmly... and strongly, we're resonating.@　Because I wanted to know you all...@　because you wanted to know me...）

0x004531.en: （That's not me... the one who thought that was Chris.）

0x004574.en: （But Riana... you must understand it too.@　You're inside me. I'm inside you...@　We're alike...）

0x004647.en: （Why... Ventos, you're a Melior Esse.@　So why is the urge to destroy@　so faint in you?）

0x0046E6.en: （And more than that, you actually@　wish to vanish...）

0x004739.en: (I was given a role unlike the other@ Melior Esse. Not even this fabricated life,@ or my own death, is mine to command.)

0x0047F7.en: （...You said it just now, didn't you,@　that we're alike.@　What did you mean by that?）

0x00487E.en: （Because we were given the same kind of role.）

0x00490B.en: （Holder of this world's knowledge...@　meaning, to understand human emotion.）

0x0049DE.en: （I can understand the human heart, and@　efficiently convert its negative wave into@　the power to awaken the King of Ruin.）

0x004A7D.en: （You're saying you'll awaken@　the King of Ruin!?）

0x004AD0.en: （I create the trigger for it...@　To the King of Ruin, I'm a connect device...@　a kind of converter.）

0x004B6C.en: （Not just input. I can also output@　the King of Ruin's power, within limits...）

0x004BDA.en: （That's why I was given the role of@　holding one pole of the Atrum Exterior@　at Septempulm.）

0x004C5E.en: （And when the King of Ruin awakens,@　my role ends. Yes, the hour@　of my destruction is already set.）

0x004D37.en: （Yes... once the King of Ruin wakes,@　I'll be unneeded. So I vanish.）

0x004DEB.en: （Sad? I understand the emotion.@　But I don't truly feel it.）

0x004E47.en: （Because I'm only one means@　of awakening the King of Ruin.@　That's the life I was given...）

0x004F27.en: 「...Any more contact is too dangerous.@　Ventos, take Glacies and pull back.@　We'll deal with them another time.」

0x00500A.en: 「Ugh... Ventos... we're withdrawing.@　At this rate, I'll...」

0x0050A3.en: 「Their power is growing beyond what we expected...!」

0x0050E3.en: 「Glacies, Ventos, we're pulling back.@　We'll deal with them another time.」

0x00514E.en: 「The Ruina are leaving the combat zone!@　N-no, wait, two units remain!」

0x0051C9.en: 「Joshua Radcliff...@　I must strike you down here...!」

0x005293.en: 「No. Keep a tight air and ground watch.@　Ask Major Gilliam to survey Pillbox 8.」

0x005301.en: 「After that, recover anything we may need,@　then return to Iti Iti Island.」

0x005366.en: 「Understood.@ I'll hurry the crew. Another Gaia Sabers@ unit may show up here.」

0x005487.en: （Glacies...@　what does this resonance between us even mean...?）

0x0054F2.en: 「Human, that new power of yours...@　I'll destroy you before it brings@　calamity down upon us.」

0x005567.en: 「Out of my way!@　My business is with Glacies!」

0x0055B7.en: 「Human, your existence@　created the trigger that erased@　the Atrum Exterior.」

0x005635.en: 「So that it never happens again,@　I'll erase your existence.」

0x00568B.en: 「This Dea Blanche Neige@　won't go down so easily!」

0x00577B.en: 「Mm, it's fine, no need to worry.@　More to the point, how's@　the Flickerei Geist holding up?」

0x005811.en: 「The Red Ogre... contact with Persoenlichkeit@ activated the Fau Kern and raised its output.」

0x0058A9.en: 「Hm... then Code U.U.N.@　can be used now?」

0x00590B.en: 「Yes.@　And the Flickerei Geist wasn't@　the only thing to activate the Fau Kern.」

0x0059BD.en: 「Yes... Duvan seeks the Persaine core@　to gain even greater power.」

0x005A43.en: 「Has he realized that yet, I wonder?」

0x005AB1.en: 「I see... and have you told the others?」

0x005AF7.en: 「That's... I didn't want to burden them@　with needless worry...」

0x005B56.en: 「And you yourself... is your body all right?」

0x005B9C.en: 「I'm managing for now...@　So please, could you keep this matter@　a secret?」

0x005C73.en: 「To think we'd meet again.@　We seem to share a strange fate.」

0x005CF4.en: 「If you're here,@　does that mean Alfimi's with you?」

0x005D4D.en: 「No... she's off resting her body somewhere.」

0x005D93.en: 「Ho ho ho.@　Not a sleeping prince but a sleeping little girl, eh?」

0x005DE6.en: 「I don't know what's so funny... but Alfimi@　may come back before long.」

0x005E5D.en: 「So long as Duvan hasn't caught her.」

0x005E97.en: 「She's tougher than she looks.@　I'm not too worried.」

0x005EF6.en: 「So you are worried, after all. Not very honest, are you?」

0x005F9F.en: 「Thank you for building the NV units@　from these blueprints.」

0x006044.en: 「Um, how exactly are you and my father...」

0x006078.en: 「Something like a student of mine.@　So I could hardly turn down his request.」

0x006129.en: 「About the same as the footage you saw.@　Only, he asked me to keep it secret@　that you're the ones who can draw out@　the NV units' true worth.」

0x006205.en: 「Felio was likely worried about you all.@　That's why he prepared that footage.@　Take his meaning from it.」

0x0062C2.en: 「...Some things you can't understand@　unless you're told straight out.」

0x00631E.en: 「Hm...@ Anyway, the Geant Aile and@ Excelsio Ars Nova...」

0x00641C.en: 「Mm, think of it as a special bonus.@　A true hidden unit, that one.」

0x0064C9.en: 「Mm. When the humanoid mobile weapons@　Ganadur and Strega go clunk and transform,@　then clank and combine, you get Forte Gigas.」

0x006876.en: 「You can't run those@　and Forte Gigas at the same time.」

0x0068CC.en: 「Then if we mount a different engine...」

0x00690C.en: 「It could be done if you tried, but@　it wouldn't put out its real power.」

0x006971.en: 「Still, swapping the Race Arcana and@　Sympatia in and out is fairly simple...」

0x0069FA.en: 「You and Lim each pilot the Geant@ Chevalier and the Dea Blanche Neige...」

0x006A80.en: 「Or the two of you ride Forte Gigas together.@　Choose as the situation calls for it.」

0x006AFB.en: 「Also, I recommend not separating Forte Gigas@　and using it in combined form.@　It performs better that way.」

0x006B97.en: 「Mind you, separation isn't fully banned.@　Depending on the situation, coordinated@　attacks by Ganadur and Strega work too.」

0x006C70.en: 「Josh...@　after the machines are loaded aboard,@　there's something I need to discuss.」

0x006D09.en: 「Yes.@　I'd like Major Kai and the others there too.」

0x006D7E.en: 「I know what you want to say.@　I'll tell her beforehand.」

0x006DFF.en: （I don't care what others think of me.@　But Lim... Chris and Riana...）

0x006E7C.en: 「Felio was likely worried about you all.@　That's why he prepared that footage.@　Take his meaning from it.」

0x006F39.en: 「Hm... anyway, I entrust the Geant Aile@ and Excelsio Ars Nova to you.@ I want you to hold back the Ruina.」

0x007090.en: 「I... I can understand her...@　like she's another version of me...」

0x00710A.en: 「She's confused, lost...@　because she took on my heart, a human heart.」

0x00716C.en: 「And she believes that at this rate,@　the being who made her will erase her...@　yet she doesn't even fear it.」

0x00720E.en: 「She simply believes that's how it'll be...」

0x007248.en: 「Ventos converts humans' negative wave@　into the power to awaken the King of Ruin...@　and once that role ends, he vanishes...」

0x007305.en: 「And he actually wishes for that to happen...」

0x00734B.en: 「...To me, you all look grieved.@　Knowing the fate laid out for those two.」

0x00744D.en: 「Yeah. You might feel better if you get it out.」

0x0074AC.en: 「I get it now...@　Glacies was given an incomplete heart,@　her life and death both bound to the 'King of Ruin'...」

0x00753C.en: 「...No. I can't do it.@　I don't want her erased.」

0x0075A8.en: 「Part of me wants to save her...@　Why? Why do I feel this way...?」

0x007625.en: 「Hmm...@　So you've gone somewhere past sorrow itself.」

0x007705.en: 「Perhaps... it's because Glacies@　is reaching out for life.」

0x007764.en: 「But it's not that she fears@　her own disappearance...」

0x0077C6.en: 「Even so, she can't afford to wither away@　before the 'King of Ruin' awakens...」

0x00783A.en: 「If she truly didn't care when she vanished,@　she'd neither resist nor flee.」

0x0078A8.en: 「Those who fight to live, those who live to fight...@　the will that says one must endure@　to fulfill one's role, all crossing paths...」

0x007B1B.en: 「But if she keeps syncing with a Melior Esse without,@　there's no telling what could happen.」

0x007B89.en: 「Doctor Cliff, is it possible to@　temporarily cut Sympatia's functions?」

0x008046.en: 「Like I said before, one of us two...」

0x00808C.en: 「I already told you that wasn't true.」

0x0080B1.en: 「That's right... which of you is the real one,@　there's no need to worry about that.」

0x008148.en: (Chris...@　I feel like Ventos is waiting for us.@　So I'm sure we'll meet again... with her.)

0x008203.en: 「Colonel Lefina, the intel we needed@　wasn't in Bunker 8.」
